svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Product roadmap 2026 subtitle: Three workstreams by quarter, what has shipped, what is in flight and what waits on what kind: timeline timeline: { scale: quarter, start: 2026-Q1, end: 2026-Q4, today: 2026-05-18 } # Each group is a lane. start and end draw a bar, date a point, milestone: true a diamond; the # status sets the style and the key under the lanes says what each style means. groups: platform: { label: Platform } product: { label: Product } growth: { label: Growth } nodes: # Items in no group share the first row: the dates the whole company works to. beta: { label: Public beta, date: 2026-03-16, milestone: true, status: done } ga: { label: General availability, date: 2026-09-30, milestone: true, status: planned } api: { in: platform, label: API v2, start: 2026-01, end: 2026-03, status: done } billing: { in: platform, label: Usage billing, start: 2026-04, end: 2026-07, status: active } sso: { in: platform, label: SSO and SCIM, start: 2026-06, end: 2026-09, status: planned } eu: { in: platform, label: EU region, start: 2026-10, end: 2026-12, status: at-risk } editor: { in: product, label: New editor, start: 2026-01, end: 2026-04, status: done } mobile: { in: product, label: Mobile app, start: 2026-05, end: 2026-09, status: active } offline: { in: product, label: Offline mode, start: 2026-10, end: 2026-12, status: planned } pricing: { in: growth, label: Pricing page, start: 2026-02, end: 2026-03, status: done } trials: { in: growth, label: Self-serve trials, start: 2026-04, end: 2026-06, status: active } partners: { in: growth, label: Partner program, start: 2026-08, end: 2026-11, status: planned } # Dependencies are finish to start: the arrow leaves the end of one item for the start of the next. edges: - api -> billing - editor -> mobile - pricing -> trials -> partners - sso -> ga

svg.title: Product roadmap 2026
svg.desc: Product roadmap 2026. Timeline by quarter from Q1 2026 to Q4 2026, 12 items in 4 lanes (Milestones, Platform, Product, Growth). Items: Public beta (Mar 16 2026, done, milestone); General availability (Sep 30 2026, planned, milestone); API v2 (Jan 1 2026 to Mar 31 2026, done); Usage billing (Apr 1 2026 to Jul 31 2026, in progress); SSO and SCIM (Jun 1 2026 to Sep 30 2026, planned); EU region (Oct 1 2026 to Dec 31 2026, at risk); New editor (Jan 1 2026 to Apr 30 2026, done); Mobile app (May 1 2026 to Sep 30 2026, in progress); Offline mode (Oct 1 2026 to Dec 31 2026, planned); Pricing page (Feb 1 2026 to Mar 31 2026, done); Self-serve trials (Apr 1 2026 to Jun 30 2026, in progress); Partner program (Aug 1 2026 to Nov 30 2026, planned). Today is May 18 2026. Dependencies: API v2 before Usage billing; New editor before Mobile app; Pricing page before Self-serve trials; Self-serve trials before Partner program; SSO and SCIM before General availability.

text.tspan: Three workstreams by quarter, what has shipped, what is in flight and what waits on what
